summary.en: Double-time riffs, palm mute, and punk tempo inside metal’s gain culture.
summary.zh: 倍速 Riff、闷音扫弦，把朋克速度塞进金属增益文化。

body.en:
Thrash hardens NWOBHM and hard rock with punk speed: downpicked sixteenth riffs, shouted vocals, and tighter song lengths than epic metal. The Bay Area / European circuits make it a parallel metal mainstream in the mid-80s.

Metallica, Megadeth, and Slayer are the teaching set—discipline and aggression as the product, not ballad gloss.
body.zh:
Thrash 用朋克速度硬化 NWOBHM 与 hard rock：下行扫弦十六分 Riff、喊叫人声、比史诗金属更短的歌曲。湾区/欧洲线路在 80 年代中期形成平行金属主流。

Metallica、Megadeth、Slayer 是教学组——产品是纪律与攻击性，不是谣曲抛光。
